SEB-301: keep the builder fed, up to 3 jobs a day, Scout splits daily when the queue is low (#674)

Seb, 25 Oct: work queued for the agents was moving too slowly. Three reasons:
- The builder took one job a day, failures included.
- The Scout split new items only on Mondays at 01:00 UTC, before the Monday
  planner queued them at 01:50, so new work waited up to a week to be split.
- On 25 Oct the builder had 2 ready jobs and 4 unsplit items.

Now: the builder takes up to 3 jobs a day, one per slot ($0.06 to $0.10 a job,
inside the $20 month cap). The Scout runs daily after the planner and makes a
model call only when fewer than 3 jobs are ready. Its SEB-300 suggestions stay
weekly. Backlog 2a and 5a are ticked: Seb's sessions built them (#663, #662)
and their rows are on main.

SEB-301: country chart opens on our own record, a range bar adds the older prices; history for 27 countries (was 10) (#659)

Agreed with Seb in chat, 24 Oct, from mocks of the Argentina page.
- The chart opens on our own record ('Since Sep' and so on). 1y, 5y and All are offered only when they add older
  prices the shorter range did not show; a country with none gets no bar.
- Our record: the purple line over a light fill, as on Routes. Older prices: the grey dashed line on a shaded band
  labelled 'Before we started, reported, not seen by us'. Hover still reads every day.
- tools/emit_country_history.py also reads the SEB-311 wide pull: USDT priced in the local currency on Binance spot,
  Bitso, Buda and CoinGecko, and the official rate from the central-bank file first, then ECB/CBC, fawazahmed0,
  Frankfurter v2. The 50% guard became a spike guard (a day 25 points off the median of the 7 days around it is left
  out; a venue with more than 2% such days is passed over), since Argentina's 2023 gap was a real 200%.
  Still only a reader of data/history; isolation check passes. 27 segment files, 1.4 MB.
- New words in copy.json: rangeSince, range_1y, range_5y, range_all, bandLabel; layerDaily is now 'Our daily record'.
No published number or method changes: the segment never feeds the index, a price or the unbroken-hours count.
